capabilities: Highlight PDF text and drag region annotations with left/right margin notes
Share one annotation collection across original and translated PDFs
Copy or move annotations between PDFs with page-range mapping
Search and batch-manage vault-wide annotations with layers and folder filters
Render Markdown footnote definitions as editable, scroll-synced sidenotes
disambiguation: Not a browser or webpage annotation extension, PDF translator, OCR service, or bibliographic reference manager; it annotates PDFs inside Obsidian's viewer and adds Markdown margin notes.
extras: Annotations are stored in vault-local files and are not embedded in the PDF, so other PDF readers will not display them. The README warns to back up data before migrating to the per-file sync store, notes that PDF features depend on Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer internals, and states the plugin makes no network requests.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer has no annotation tools, and Markdown footnotes can only be read at the bottom of a note, not beside the text.

relations.evidence: This is not a complete Everything Bilink replacement

summary: PDF annotation plugin that adds highlights, margin notes, shared collections between PDFs, and renders Markdown footnotes as editable margin sidenotes.
